name: Pink World 2 -Farm Edition-
source:
A young girl named Eileen is excited to start her first day as an intern on a farm. However said farm and by extension the world change forever when a flash of pink light hits.

[From [url=https://annon.itch.io/pinkworld-2]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
名叫艾琳的年轻女孩满心雀跃地迎来了她在农场担任实习生的第一天。然而，随着一道粉色光芒骤然降临，这座农场乃至整个世界都彻底改变了模样。

[摘自[url=https://annon.itch.io/pinkworld-2]itch.io[/url]]
